slides.title: Work Me Lord
slides.body: Janis Joplin brought the full force of her voice to Woodstock’s Sunday night program.

slides.title: What you are watching
slides.body: Joplin arrived at Woodstock already established as one of the era's most commanding singers. ‘Work Me Lord’ shows the performance not as a studio artifact, but as a high-wire exchange between voice, band, and exhausted festival crowd.
